summary: John's 2nd great-grandmother; born 1867 in the Schuylkill County coal town of New Philadelphia to an Irish-born father; wife of Henry J. Meier.
bio:
Annie A. Higgins was born 2 Oct 1867 in New Philadelphia, Schuylkill County, PA (marriage docket No. 11054). She was living in Hazleton when she married Henry J. Meier there on 1 Mar 1892 (licence 10 Feb 1892). In 1910 (14 Mill St, Wilkes-Barre) she was 42, born PA, father born Ireland, mother born PA, mother of 7 children of whom 6 were living. She appears as Anna (52) in 1920 at 298 Barney St and Anna A. (72) in 1940 at 16 Barney St. FamilySearch (LBV1-4CM) calls her 'Anna Agnes', died 6 Oct 1951 in Wilkes-Barre, buried St. Mary's Cemetery, Hanover Twp. (Find a Grave index QVG4-98JK); it names her parents as William Higgins and Mary Ann Reilly, but the parent profiles have no sources and web searches for them (and for a William Higgins of New Philadelphia) found nothing. The Ancestry tree shows 'Anna Higgins (Deceased)' with parents empty. Higgins was a common Irish Catholic name in the Freeland–Drifton–Hazleton coal patch in the 1890s (e.g. William Higgins of Ridge and Main streets, Freeland; Andrew Higgins of Freeland, a Hazleton clerk; Frank Higgins m. Hannah Thomas at St. Ann's, Freeland; a 'Miss Annie Higgins' who married John Shovlin at Silver Brook in 1891 — none linked).

The Pennsylvania death-certificate index for 1951 lists "Anna Meier", Wilkes-Barre, Luzerne County (county 40), died 10-06-51, certificate file 86969 ([R4-S1]). This independently confirms the FamilySearch death date and gives the number needed to order her certificate, which should name her parents. A search of the 1890 Schuylkill County census directory ([R4-S2]) found no Higgins household in New Philadelphia borough, so the family had probably left the town before 1890; Higgins households were listed elsewhere in the county (Norwegian Twp, Mahanoy, Pottsville etc.), none of them a William with wife Mary Ann.

Name in the Ancestry tree: "Anna Higgins"; research uses "Anna A. Higgins".

Resolved: Her 1951 PA death certificate (Ancestry PA Death Certificates 1906–1970) should name her parents and their birthplaces. → Not yet seen, but the certificate is now identified: PA 1951 death file no. 86969 (Wilkes-Barre, 6 Oct 1951). Order from PA State Archives or view on Ancestry.

Round 4 searched without result: Schuylkill census directory 1890 (archive.org full text): no Higgins in New Philadelphia; Biographical and Portrait Cyclopedia of Schuylkill County (1893), Schalck & Henning History of Schuylkill County (1907), Schuylkill County genealogy (1916), Boyd's Pottsville directory 1869-70 (archive.org full texts): no William Higgins / Reilly of New Philadelphia; WebSearch: Higgins + "Mary Ann Reilly" + Schuylkill/Hazleton/New Philadelphia: nothing; FamilySearch parent profiles G7LM-H5M (William Higgins) and G7LM-T4K (Mary Ann Reilly): no events, no sources
Round 4: found 1951 PA death index entry (file 86969); parents still unsourced; 1890 New Philadelphia directory negative.
